question: How should the practitioner draw in the vital air at the root of the tongue and palate?
premises: The action is located at the root of the tongue and palate.
The practitioner should take in the air.
The action should be done slowly.
inference: Having fixed attention at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the air.
plain_english: Having placed it at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the air.
